reason: @bunli/runtime -> @opentui/core -> Jimp pulls the old CommonJS file-type API. These CLIs use command parsing and JSON/text output, not image rendering or Jimp.read on untrusted bytes. A major override breaks the Jimp API; replace/upgrade the upstream renderer dependency before allowing image inputs.

Direct CLI validation uses patched Zod 4.6.7. Jimp plugins retain Zod 3 for their image-operation schemas. The CLI does not call image operations or pass untrusted arrays to those schemas. Do not force a cross-major override into Jimp; revisit with its upstream upgrade.
